name: creating-data-visualizations
title: 创建数据可视化
description: This skill enables Claude to generate data visualizations, plots, charts, and graphs from provided data. It analyzes the data, selects the most appropriate visualization type, and creates a visually appealing and informative graphic. Use this skill when the user requests a visualization, plot, chart, or graph; when data needs to be presented visually; or when exploring data patterns.
